fields.description: Route approvals via Employee Grade limits and Reports To. Managers below the amount limit may only Reject or Escalate. Configure per-grade amounts on the Approval and Advance Limits page.
fields.label: Use Grade + Reports To Approval

fields.description: Superseded by Use Grade + Reports To Approval. Kept so sites mid-migration keep routing by chain instead of falling back to amount tiers.
fields.label: Use Grade Approval (legacy field)
Legacy Amount Tiers (fallback when grade approval is off)

fields.description: Above this amount, prefer Purchase Order / vendor payment. Reimbursement may continue with a reason.
fields.label: Vendor Payment Threshold

fields.description: Legacy field retained for compatibility only. Request count and outstanding balances no longer restrict new employee advances.
fields.label: Max Unsettled Advances (legacy, unused)

fields.description: Used only to prefer an employee's own advance over Manager Advance when submitting expense claims, and to flag residuals in reporting. Does not limit new advance requests. Residuals are not auto-written-off.
fields.label: Manager Advance Source Residual %

fields.description: Unused. Advances are not tagged to a project. Set Project on Expense Claims and Purchase Orders for budget tracking.
fields.label: Default Advance Project

fields.description: Optional. When > 0, Expense Claims for an employee in a calendar month cannot exceed this total (0 = disabled). Expense Claim = reimbursement for money you already paid.
fields.label: Monthly Reimbursement Cap (per employee)

fields.description: Block approval when proposed spend exceeds allocated budget by more than this percent. Board of Directors grade always overrides.
fields.label: Budget Hard-Block Overspend %

fields.description: Optional role allowed to authorise a Strict Project or Expense Account budget override. Board of Directors grade is always authorised.
fields.label: Budget Override Role (optional)
